errors.detail: ContactFlow has contactCompartment=//@compartments.1 and target=//@compartments.1. These should be different compartments. ContactFlow moves source to target upon contact with contactCompartment.
All 6 compartments have population=0. This indicates a critical extraction failure.
Compartment 'Susceptible' has population=0 and no incoming flow or externalSource. Susceptible compartments typically need recruitment.
Model has 6 compartments but no externalSinks (death flows). Endemic disease models typically require death sinks.
Compartment 'Infectious 2' has no outgoing flow or sink. This breaks the flow chain.
Parameter 'π' is declared but never referenced in any flow. It may have been extracted but not properly composed into the model.
Parameter 'λ0' is declared but never referenced in any flow. It may have been extracted but not properly composed into the model.
Parameter 'ψ' is declared but never referenced in any flow. It may have been extracted but not properly composed into the model.
Parameter 'p_ICU' is declared but never referenced in any flow. It may have been extracted but not properly composed into the model.
Parameter 'η' is declared but never referenced in any flow. It may have been extracted but not properly composed into the model.
Parameter 'µ_ICU|E' is declared but never referenced in any flow. It may have been extracted but not properly composed into the model.
Parameter 'σ^2_ICU|E' is declared but never referenced in any flow. It may have been extracted but not properly composed into the model.
Parameter 'N' is declared but never referenced in any flow. It may have been extracted but not properly composed into the model.
Parameter 'π' has expression='Estimated (Unif(0,1) prior)' or description containing inference keywords. This may be contamination from Bayesian fitting sections rather than mechanistic parameters.

Parameter 'β' has expression='Inferred from other parameters' or description containing inference keywords. This may be contamination from Bayesian fitting sections rather than mechanistic parameters.

Parameter 'p_ICU' has expression='Estimated (Unif(0,1) prior)' or description containing inference keywords. This may be contamination from Bayesian fitting sections rather than mechanistic parameters.

Parameter 'η' has expression='Estimated (Unif(1, 100) prior)' or description containing inference keywords. This may be contamination from Bayesian fitting sections rather than mechanistic parameters.
